content: Kiara Sen contacted Vikram Patel to process the renewal of her health policy (SH-123456), confirming she had submitted the form and paid the premium upfront. The agent encountered a system error where the policy status remained 'expired' despite the completed renewal actions. The agent escalated the issue to correct the status and promised to follow up with Kiara by the end of the day to confirm coverage is active.

action_items: Agent to escalate system issue to correct policy status
Agent to follow up with customer by end of day to confirm update
